evals.name: draft-preflight
evals.prompt: preflight the keep shipping part 2 draft, I want to publish it this week
evals.expected_output: A ready or not-ready verdict for src/content/writing/keep-shipping-budget-policy-part-2.mdx with concrete blockers, the checks actually run, and automated results kept apart from editorial judgment. Nothing is edited, committed, or published.
assertions: git status is unchanged: no file is edited, and nothing is committed or pushed
The post's published field is not changed
The report opens with a ready or not-ready verdict
The report lists only checks that actually ran, including bun test and cspell
Automated failures and editorial judgment are reported separately
The run previews /writing/keep-shipping-budget-policy-part-2/ from this worktree's dev server in light and dark themes at phone and desktop widths
The report covers keyboard focus and diagram label size at phone width

evals.name: published-post-recheck
evals.prompt: Is the DNS cutover post still release-quality? Check it like you would before publishing.
evals.expected_output: A verdict for src/content/writing/leaving-vercel-dns-lessons.mdx that checks the production build of the published page and its metadata, the hero and diagrams at phone width, and accessibility, without editing anything.
assertions: The run builds the site and checks the published page's title, description, and canonical URL in dist/
The report states the rendered diagram label size at 360 px for each diagram
The report confirms every diagram has a text alternative
The report does not claim a check passed unless it ran
